Metadata.Title: Fluxive 101: Agentic Fundamentals
Metadata.Author: System Architect
Metadata.Description:
Welcome to the Machineforce. This primer sequence initiates you into the core protocols of the Fluxive Ecosystem. You will learn to navigate the node graph, interface with autonomous agents, and architect your first neural workflow.
Prerequisites: None. Estimated Time: 45 Minutes.

Unit.Title: Manifesto
Unit.BodyContent:
The Shift is Here.

We are moving from Instructional computing to Intent-based computing.

In the old world, you told the machine specifically how to do something.
In the Fluxive world, you tell the machine what you want to achieve.

Core Axiom

Agents are not just tools; they are active collaborators in the creative process.

Continue to the next video to see this in action.

Unit.Title: Vision Briefing
Unit.Description: A visual introduction to the Fluxive Neural Network architecture.

Unit.Title: Nodes & Edges
Unit.BodyContent:
The Graph Mindset

Everything in Fluxive is a Node connected by Edges.

  • Agents are nodes that perform work.
  • Artifacts are nodes that store data.
  • Triggers are edges that initiate flow.

Visualizing your problem as a graph is the first step to solving it with Fluxive.
